title: Polyinference · parallel development, serialized verification
description: Per-agent private copies; one global shell command; one merge/reconciliation/assessment/commit/publication owner; all local completions unresolved.

nodes.title: Cloud senior · invocation modes
nodes.subtitle: CLOUD PIPE / STRATEGY
nodes.body: One cloud-model node owns all senior work. Its prompt changes with the invocation reason, rather than creating a separate node for each prompt. INITIAL: receive the user objective, repository snapshot, acceptance criteria, and run limits; interpret the project and propose a first sprint. SPRINT REVIEW: compare planned work with task reports, commits, and test evidence; explain what went well and wrong, revise assumptions, and assign the next sprint. SPECIALIST TASK: occasionally solve an explicitly assigned difficult problem using the same bounded tool and evidence contracts as the local worker. COMPLETION REVIEW: decide whether project-level verification is justified. The first model inference in a new run is always here. this box defines the role and prompt mode; inference happens through Query Processor → Cloud process entry → Cloud conductor. It is not a second paid call before the OS entry. Specialist actions, observations, verification and repairs use the shared evidence boundary.
facts: Think of this model as the senior engineer and the sprint meeting. It is called at sprint boundaries or concrete exceptions, not after every local action.
A planning response contains a short sprint goal and scoped work items: task ID, dependencies, base revision, allowed tools, instructions, acceptance checks, local/cloud role, and attempt limits.

Review prompts receive a bounded retrospective packet with successful/failed work, observations, tests, checkpoint SHAs, unresolved risks, queue state, and remaining resources; full traces remain retrievable artifacts.
Review, planning, difficult-task execution, and completion use modes of this same node. A single response can review the previous sprint and plan the next.

The common inference gateway enforces context fit, sharing policy, endpoint health, retries, usage accounting, and reserved cloud budget. Required cloud access that is unavailable pauses or stops the run honestly.
pressure may request an explicit eligible assignment change, never silently weaken criteria or role authority.

contract.input: invocation_reason: initial | sprint_review | plan_correction | specialist_task | specialist_observation | specialist_repair | completion_review; objective; evidence_refs; remaining_budget
contract.output: sprint plan + retrospective | bounded specialist action/candidate | completion_candidate | blocked

nodes.title: Project acceptance
nodes.subtitle: AGENT DELIVERY
nodes.body: The senior proposes project completion after reviewing local results. Check current project criteria and the reviewed resulting revision. A local successful verdict is not project completion. Pending steering is applied at its prescribed planner boundary; queue exhaustion alone does not prove success.
facts: Local final assessment and senior/project review are distinct stages.

contract.input: senior completion proposal + reviewed revision/evidence + current planning state
contract.output: project outcome with evidence, or concrete review issues

nodes.title: Local loop · develop / assess
nodes.subtitle: AGENT LOOP / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Run in this process's private code copy. Ordinary implementation reasoning and non-shell edits can overlap other agents. Every shell operation uses shell_mutex. Before final testing, request verification ownership, merge latest head and run the special reconciliation development loop. The final one/few local iterations test/examine/assess. A repair inside verification returns to development, then final assessment again. All phases and allowances are explicit.

contract.input: private workspace; phase=development|reconciliation|assessment; observations; token refs; bounds
contract.output: inference/action proposal; candidate requesting verification; assessment evidence/verdict

nodes.title: Tools / scoped observations
nodes.subtitle: AGENT ACTIONS / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Run tools against the declared process copy. Every shell/script action requires current shell_mutex ownership, including commands during reconciliation, assessment or commit. Non-shell private edits do not need a global coding lock. Return paired observations and relevant completion/effect state. Release shell only after the operation and relevant background effects ended; shared external resources need explicit scope/conflict rules.

contract.input: scoped action; workspace; shell token if shell; phase/operation identity
contract.output: paired observation + revision/effects + confirmed/unknown completion

nodes.title: Final test / examination / assessment
nodes.subtitle: FINAL LOCAL LOOP PHASE
nodes.body: The last one/few local LLM loops assess the reconciled private tree while verification_gate remains owned. Run tests/examination through the same local inference/tools path; shell commands take shell_mutex individually. Assessment produces fail, uncertain or successful. Any repair requires another final assessment. Missing assessment means interrupted/assessment-pending, not normal completion.

contract.input: verification token; reconciled tree; assessment prompt/evidence; remaining allowance
contract.output: assessment_complete + fail|uncertain|successful + exact tree/evidence

nodes.title: Commit / publish / unresolved report
nodes.subtitle: AGENT RETURN / STILL VERIFY OWNER
nodes.body: Before releasing verification ownership, create the attributable agent commit P and publish provisional_head=P with the immutable unresolved report. Prefer parent(P)=captured H and the final assessed tree so senior revert undoes this agent's net delta, not incoming predecessor changes. Retain original B/private merge history as evidence. Every normally completed verdict, including fail/uncertain, publishes provisionally with hazards and remains unresolved. Publication is not senior approval; a private-only commit is insufficient for the next agent.

contract.input: verification token; B; captured H; final assessed tree; verdict/evidence; actual commit P
contract.output: durable provisional_head=P + execution=completed,resolution=unresolved report; then gate release

nodes.title: Cloud process entry · ready
nodes.subtitle: OS
nodes.body: durable ready/admission queue for cloud processes, distinct from the worker Task Queue. Validate caller, grant, versions, required capabilities and limits. Waiting for quota does not occupy a host thread or imply that a provider job has begun. Dispatch admitted work to the existing cloud conductor.

contract.input: CloudProcessSpec + expected control/binding versions
contract.output: ready/waiting receipt → conductor; or typed invalid/unsupported/denied result

nodes.title: Cloud Query Processor
nodes.subtitle: CLOUD PIPE
nodes.body: build one versioned CloudProcessSpec from the selected senior prompt mode or claimed cloud-specialist task. Include bounded context/evidence refs, expected output schema, required model_inference/agent_job execution kind, allowed tools/providers, fallback policy, priority, finite limits, binding version, stable logical-step identity and return target. Submit it to the OS; this is packaging, not a model call.

contract.input: invocation reason + pinned project/task/steering/context refs + allowed binding/limits
contract.output: validated CloudProcessSpec + stable process/operation identity

nodes.title: Task queue · completed unresolved
nodes.subtitle: AGENT TASK LEDGER
nodes.body: Worker-task ledger: pending, in-progress and completed-unresolved processes. Each started agent owns a private copy. Provisional shared publication occurs inside verification ownership before release, including fail/uncertain commits with hazards; it never resolves the report. Only sprint-coordinator review resolves outputs. Steering stops new starts and waits for already-in-progress local agents, including lock waiters, then goes to the planner. Pending unstarted queue items do not need to finish.
facts: All normal completions remain unresolved, including successful.
Provisional head and reviewed disposition are separate.
Original base, captured head, assessed tree and published commit remain attributable.

contract.input: TaskSpecs; completed unresolved TaskReports; senior dispositions; steering dispatch gate
contract.output: claimed task; unresolved result history; pending work; dependency/hazard context

nodes.title: Orchestrator / loop handler
nodes.subtitle: AGENT CONTROL / OS SERVICES
nodes.body: Program-level control for the agent design. The LLM OS operates LLM/tool endpoints; it does not integrate with Linux or enter computer-kernel space. Record steering and stop new local starts, but let the captured currently-in-progress local agents finish their original implementation, final assessment, commit and unresolved report. Then invoke the sprint planner to apply steering and resolve outputs. The pending task queue does not have to finish. Keep control/status/completion handling active while shell/verification ownership is held.
facts: Steering does not change running agents' goals or task specifications.
A started local agent waiting on inference/tools/the coding gate is in progress. Pending unstarted queue tasks are excluded.
All completed local processes remain unresolved until sprint-coordinator review, including successful ones.

contract.input: objective; queue/report events; pressure; pending steering + captured running-local IDs
contract.output: typed dispatch/planning requests; drain bookkeeping; resume/status; reviewed dispositions

nodes.title: Cloud result processor
nodes.subtitle: CLOUD PIPE
nodes.body: Normalize cloud plan/review proposals and specialist results. Validate scope, schema, limits and actual accepted plan versions. Review decisions identify the completed-unresolved agent report and commit, then route to Senior resolution for keep/revert/retry/defer. Initial/next plans update the queue. Steering receipt alone does not invalidate running local agents' original plan or reports: the sprint planner applies pending steering only after the captured running-local set finishes. A completion proposal goes to Project acceptance.
facts: All local verdicts require sprint-coordinator resolution.
Notes are versioned context; tool grants and code review remain explicit.
Steering input sequence differs from accepted plan revision.

contract.input: typed cloud result + accepted plan/head versions + unresolved reports + planner input range
contract.output: validated plan | senior resolution decision | specialist action/candidate | completion proposal

nodes.title: Local inference
nodes.subtitle: OS / INFERENCE
nodes.body: Shared local inference service, one component of the OS. accept a bounded prompt and stable operation identity, check context fit and shared memory/decode admission, execute the configured model, and return a typed output to Local result processor. This component does not independently authorize tools, change task scope, verify completion or become the whole OS.

contract.input: prompt/context refs + limits + operation/binding identity
contract.output: model output/action proposal + actual model/version + usage + typed status

nodes.title: Result / phase / workspace router
nodes.subtitle: AGENT LOOP / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Interpret model/tool output with process workspace and phase. Private non-shell edits use only their workspace scope; shell proposals request shell_mutex. An ordinary development candidate requests verification_gate, not direct final assessment. After merge/reconciliation development, enter final assessment under the same gate. Only completed final assessment produces fail/uncertain/successful for commit/report. No verdict resolves the task.

contract.input: phase-aware output/observation + private workspace + ownership refs
contract.output: private continuation | shell request | verification entry | assessment result

nodes.title: Documentation · versioned batches
nodes.subtitle: DATA / DOCS
nodes.body: retain report change briefs and final queue dispositions, including cancellations, in a deduplicated durable backlog. At a batch threshold or senior review, capture an input range and accepted code revision. If generation is needed, enqueue a bounded doc-update task through Task Queue, rather than writing into an active worker workspace. Publish a new doc version and advance the consumed cursor together; failed updates keep the backlog. Workers use pinned versions or explicit unprocessed deltas.
facts: The backlog survives interruption even before a model-generated update exists.
Do not make a doc update recursively wait on consuming its own report.
Summary text cannot rewrite grants, evidence or accepted history.

contract.input: report/disposition events + current docs + captured code revision + batch cursor
contract.output: bounded doc TaskSpec OR versioned docs + acknowledged event range

nodes.title: USER PROMPT
nodes.subtitle: CUSTOM STATE
nodes.body: Long running prompt by the user to be worked on

nodes.title: Cloud conductor / execution
nodes.subtitle: OS / CLOUD RUNTIME
nodes.body: execute the declared protocol. An agent endpoint uses its native session/turn/job lifecycle. A raw LLM uses a bounded host action/observation loop where the task requires agentic behavior; a structured planning query may use one generation. Never pretend a raw reply is an autonomous job and never nest a competing tool loop around an existing agent harness. report account-wide quota/rate/spend/health pressure with observation time and unknown fields. Enforce allowed overflow and stable submission/reconciliation rules. Specialist tools use the shared guarded boundary or an adapter contract with equivalent scope and evidence.
facts: Subscription quota windows are provider-reported/configured, not universally five-hour/weekly/monthly.
One mutable session operation at a time; all OS-managed processes share account admission.
A timeout/interrupt request does not prove the external job stopped.
Resume or rebind only at a supported settled boundary; retain unknown effects and accounting.

contract.input: admitted CloudProcessSpec | specialist observation/repair + operation/binding refs
contract.output: typed cloud step/terminal result; actual provider/model and usage; pressure snapshot; cancellation/uncertainty status

nodes.title: Immediate memory / pending steering
nodes.subtitle: AGENT DATA / OS STORAGE
nodes.body: Store objective, versioned notes/hazards and ordered steering. Steering is recorded now but applied later by the sprint planner. Signal the orchestrator to stop new local starts and capture currently-in-progress local IDs. Those agents finish on their old instructions; pending queue work does not run merely to empty the queue. Once captured agents have completed assessment/commit/report, send steering and unresolved results to the planner. The captured running set includes agents waiting for shell_mutex or verification_gate; those waiters must be allowed to enter and finish. Hazards track provisional fail/uncertain commits that later private copies merge.
facts: No immediate goal change, cancellation or replan on ordinary steering receipt.
New steering is retained by sequence/range; no lost input.
Hazards identify whether an unresolved change is present in current code or isolated elsewhere.

contract.input: objective; steering events; notes/hazard updates
contract.output: pending steering range; dispatch-gate signal; captured-running-set refs; pinned context

nodes.title: Resume / owner / publication manifest
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION CONTINUATION
nodes.body: Persist private workspace/base, current development/reconciliation/assessment phase, captured shared head, both owner-token refs, pending shell/provider effects, commit/report/publication status and graph checkpoint. A crash or timeout does not prove protected work stopped. Reconcile effects and publication before releasing applicable exclusion or resuming. An old owner cannot publish without a fresh current-token/version check.

contract.input: process continuation + workspace/phase + both owners + pending effects/publication
contract.output: validated resume or explicit reconciliation wait/abort; no duplicated publication

nodes.title: Senior resolution / commit undo
nodes.subtitle: AGENT REVIEW / OS ACTIONS
nodes.body: Only sprint-coordinator review resolves completed reports. Keep/revert/retry/defer is separate from provisional shared publication and the local assessment verdict. A revert acquires verification_gate, takes shell_mutex for commands, checks later/dependent work and blast radius, then publishes its new head before release. Retain original/revert commit relationships. Git avoids reconstructing inverse edits but does not remove conflict/dependency analysis.

contract.input: senior decision; original/provisional commits; dependents; expected shared head
contract.output: review disposition + recorded keep/revert/retry/defer; resulting head/checks

nodes.title: Verification critical section
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION OWNERSHIP
nodes.body: One process at a time owns final reconciliation through shared publication. Acquire only after outside shell ownership is released. Capture latest provisional head H, merge it into the private copy, run at least one specially prompted development loop, then final assessment, commit and shared head/report publication before release. The coordinator remains active; other agents continue private development. Inside this section acquire shell_mutex individually for commands, always in verification→shell order.

contract.input: ready private candidate + task/process; no held outside shell token
contract.output: queued | verification owner token + captured H | reconciled release

nodes.title: Shell mutex · one command
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION OWNERSHIP
nodes.body: Every managed shell/script command uses one global shell mutex, even when agents have separate code copies. This includes Git/build/test commands invoked through shell. Release after actual relevant completion, not merely command launch or timeout. Outside verification, finish/release shell before requesting verification. Inside verification, acquire/release shell per command; do not hold it while reasoning. Native/remote agent shell work must be brokered or declared incompatible with this guarantee.

contract.input: shell request + process/workspace + optional verification token
contract.output: queued | sole shell owner + command result | release/unknown-effect wait

nodes.title: Private code copy · base B
nodes.subtitle: AGENT / PER-PROCESS WORKSPACE
nodes.body: Every in-progress coding agent gets its own codebase copy at a recorded base B. Private non-shell edits, context preparation and model reasoning can overlap. All tool requests identify this workspace. Start with full working trees; a partial copy requires dependency/build/test closure and a full-project mapping before publication.

contract.input: claimed task + process + base B + required project context
contract.output: private workspace/ref + scoped tool context

nodes.title: Merge head / reconciliation dev
nodes.subtitle: AGENT / VERIFICATION PHASE
nodes.body: While holding verification_gate, preserve the private pre-merge delta, merge current shared head H into this agent copy, resolve conflicts, and run at least one LLM development loop with a special prompt to inspect incoming changes and necessary adaptations. Run this even after a clean merge. Bound further repair work, then run final testing/examination/assessment. Shell operations still use shell_mutex individually.

contract.input: verification token; original B/private delta; latest H; task/observations
contract.output: updated private tree + reconciliation loop evidence -> final assessment

nodes.subtitle: AGENT DELIVERY
nodes.body: The senior proposes project completion after reviewing local results. Check current project criteria and the reviewed resulting revision. A local successful verdict is not project completion. Pending steering is applied at its prescribed planner boundary; queue exhaustion alone does not prove success.
facts: Local final assessment and senior/project review are distinct stages.

contract.input: senior completion proposal + reviewed revision/evidence + current planning state
contract.output: project outcome with evidence, or concrete review issues

nodes.title: Local loop · develop / assess
nodes.subtitle: AGENT LOOP / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Run in this process's private code copy. Ordinary implementation reasoning and non-shell edits can overlap other agents. Every shell operation uses shell_mutex. Before final testing, request verification ownership, merge latest head and run the special reconciliation development loop. The final one/few local iterations test/examine/assess. A repair inside verification returns to development, then final assessment again. All phases and allowances are explicit.

contract.input: private workspace; phase=development|reconciliation|assessment; observations; token refs; bounds
contract.output: inference/action proposal; candidate requesting verification; assessment evidence/verdict

nodes.title: Tools / scoped observations
nodes.subtitle: AGENT ACTIONS / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Run tools against the declared process copy. Every shell/script action requires current shell_mutex ownership, including commands during reconciliation, assessment or commit. Non-shell private edits do not need a global coding lock. Return paired observations and relevant completion/effect state. Release shell only after the operation and relevant background effects ended; shared external resources need explicit scope/conflict rules.

contract.input: scoped action; workspace; shell token if shell; phase/operation identity
contract.output: paired observation + revision/effects + confirmed/unknown completion

nodes.title: Final test / examination / assessment
nodes.subtitle: FINAL LOCAL LOOP PHASE
nodes.body: The last one/few local LLM loops assess the reconciled private tree while verification_gate remains owned. Run tests/examination through the same local inference/tools path; shell commands take shell_mutex individually. Assessment produces fail, uncertain or successful. Any repair requires another final assessment. Missing assessment means interrupted/assessment-pending, not normal completion.

contract.input: verification token; reconciled tree; assessment prompt/evidence; remaining allowance
contract.output: assessment_complete + fail|uncertain|successful + exact tree/evidence

nodes.title: Commit / publish / unresolved report
nodes.subtitle: AGENT RETURN / STILL VERIFY OWNER
nodes.body: Before releasing verification ownership, create the attributable agent commit P and publish provisional_head=P with the immutable unresolved report. Prefer parent(P)=captured H and the final assessed tree so senior revert undoes this agent's net delta, not incoming predecessor changes. Retain original B/private merge history as evidence. Every normally completed verdict, including fail/uncertain, publishes provisionally with hazards and remains unresolved. Publication is not senior approval; a private-only commit is insufficient for the next agent.

contract.input: verification token; B; captured H; final assessed tree; verdict/evidence; actual commit P
contract.output: durable provisional_head=P + execution=completed,resolution=unresolved report; then gate release

nodes.title: Cloud process entry · ready
nodes.subtitle: OS
nodes.body: durable ready/admission queue for cloud processes, distinct from the worker Task Queue. Validate caller, grant, versions, required capabilities and limits. Waiting for quota does not occupy a host thread or imply that a provider job has begun. Dispatch admitted work to the existing cloud conductor.

contract.input: CloudProcessSpec + expected control/binding versions
contract.output: ready/waiting receipt → conductor; or typed invalid/unsupported/denied result

nodes.title: Cloud Query Processor
nodes.subtitle: CLOUD PIPE
nodes.body: build one versioned CloudProcessSpec from the selected senior prompt mode or claimed cloud-specialist task. Include bounded context/evidence refs, expected output schema, required model_inference/agent_job execution kind, allowed tools/providers, fallback policy, priority, finite limits, binding version, stable logical-step identity and return target. Submit it to the OS; this is packaging, not a model call.

contract.input: invocation reason + pinned project/task/steering/context refs + allowed binding/limits
contract.output: validated CloudProcessSpec + stable process/operation identity

nodes.title: Task queue · completed unresolved
nodes.subtitle: AGENT TASK LEDGER
nodes.body: Worker-task ledger: pending, in-progress and completed-unresolved processes. Each started agent owns a private copy. Provisional shared publication occurs inside verification ownership before release, including fail/uncertain commits with hazards; it never resolves the report. Only sprint-coordinator review resolves outputs. Steering stops new starts and waits for already-in-progress local agents, including lock waiters, then goes to the planner. Pending unstarted queue items do not need to finish.
facts: All normal completions remain unresolved, including successful.
Provisional head and reviewed disposition are separate.
Original base, captured head, assessed tree and published commit remain attributable.

contract.input: TaskSpecs; completed unresolved TaskReports; senior dispositions; steering dispatch gate
contract.output: claimed task; unresolved result history; pending work; dependency/hazard context

nodes.title: Orchestrator / loop handler
nodes.subtitle: AGENT CONTROL / OS SERVICES
nodes.body: Program-level control for the agent design. The LLM OS operates LLM/tool endpoints; it does not integrate with Linux or enter computer-kernel space. Record steering and stop new local starts, but let the captured currently-in-progress local agents finish their original implementation, final assessment, commit and unresolved report. Then invoke the sprint planner to apply steering and resolve outputs. The pending task queue does not have to finish. Keep control/status/completion handling active while shell/verification ownership is held.
facts: Steering does not change running agents' goals or task specifications.
A started local agent waiting on inference/tools/the coding gate is in progress. Pending unstarted queue tasks are excluded.
All completed local processes remain unresolved until sprint-coordinator review, including successful ones.

contract.input: objective; queue/report events; pressure; pending steering + captured running-local IDs
contract.output: typed dispatch/planning requests; drain bookkeeping; resume/status; reviewed dispositions

nodes.title: Cloud result processor
nodes.subtitle: CLOUD PIPE
nodes.body: Normalize cloud plan/review proposals and specialist results. Validate scope, schema, limits and actual accepted plan versions. Review decisions identify the completed-unresolved agent report and commit, then route to Senior resolution for keep/revert/retry/defer. Initial/next plans update the queue. Steering receipt alone does not invalidate running local agents' original plan or reports: the sprint planner applies pending steering only after the captured running-local set finishes. A completion proposal goes to Project acceptance.
facts: All local verdicts require sprint-coordinator resolution.
Notes are versioned context; tool grants and code review remain explicit.
Steering input sequence differs from accepted plan revision.

contract.input: typed cloud result + accepted plan/head versions + unresolved reports + planner input range
contract.output: validated plan | senior resolution decision | specialist action/candidate | completion proposal

nodes.title: Local inference
nodes.subtitle: OS / INFERENCE
nodes.body: Shared local inference service, one component of the OS. accept a bounded prompt and stable operation identity, check context fit and shared memory/decode admission, execute the configured model, and return a typed output to Local result processor. This component does not independently authorize tools, change task scope, verify completion or become the whole OS.

contract.input: prompt/context refs + limits + operation/binding identity
contract.output: model output/action proposal + actual model/version + usage + typed status

nodes.title: Result / phase / workspace router
nodes.subtitle: AGENT LOOP / OS-HANDLED
nodes.body: Interpret model/tool output with process workspace and phase. Private non-shell edits use only their workspace scope; shell proposals request shell_mutex. An ordinary development candidate requests verification_gate, not direct final assessment. After merge/reconciliation development, enter final assessment under the same gate. Only completed final assessment produces fail/uncertain/successful for commit/report. No verdict resolves the task.

contract.input: phase-aware output/observation + private workspace + ownership refs
contract.output: private continuation | shell request | verification entry | assessment result

nodes.title: Documentation · versioned batches
nodes.subtitle: DATA / DOCS
nodes.body: retain report change briefs and final queue dispositions, including cancellations, in a deduplicated durable backlog. At a batch threshold or senior review, capture an input range and accepted code revision. If generation is needed, enqueue a bounded doc-update task through Task Queue, rather than writing into an active worker workspace. Publish a new doc version and advance the consumed cursor together; failed updates keep the backlog. Workers use pinned versions or explicit unprocessed deltas.
facts: The backlog survives interruption even before a model-generated update exists.
Do not make a doc update recursively wait on consuming its own report.
Summary text cannot rewrite grants, evidence or accepted history.

contract.input: report/disposition events + current docs + captured code revision + batch cursor
contract.output: bounded doc TaskSpec OR versioned docs + acknowledged event range

nodes.title: USER PROMPT
nodes.subtitle: CUSTOM STATE
nodes.body: Long running prompt by the user to be worked on

nodes.title: Immediate memory / pending steering
nodes.subtitle: AGENT DATA / OS STORAGE
nodes.body: Store objective, versioned notes/hazards and ordered steering. Steering is recorded now but applied later by the sprint planner. Signal the orchestrator to stop new local starts and capture currently-in-progress local IDs. Those agents finish on their old instructions; pending queue work does not run merely to empty the queue. Once captured agents have completed assessment/commit/report, send steering and unresolved results to the planner. The captured running set includes agents waiting for shell_mutex or verification_gate; those waiters must be allowed to enter and finish. Hazards track provisional fail/uncertain commits that later private copies merge.
facts: No immediate goal change, cancellation or replan on ordinary steering receipt.
New steering is retained by sequence/range; no lost input.
Hazards identify whether an unresolved change is present in current code or isolated elsewhere.

contract.input: objective; steering events; notes/hazard updates
contract.output: pending steering range; dispatch-gate signal; captured-running-set refs; pinned context

nodes.title: Cloud conductor / execution
nodes.subtitle: OS / CLOUD RUNTIME
nodes.body: execute the declared protocol. An agent endpoint uses its native session/turn/job lifecycle. A raw LLM uses a bounded host action/observation loop where the task requires agentic behavior; a structured planning query may use one generation. Never pretend a raw reply is an autonomous job and never nest a competing tool loop around an existing agent harness. report account-wide quota/rate/spend/health pressure with observation time and unknown fields. Enforce allowed overflow and stable submission/reconciliation rules. Specialist tools use the shared guarded boundary or an adapter contract with equivalent scope and evidence.
facts: Subscription quota windows are provider-reported/configured, not universally five-hour/weekly/monthly.
One mutable session operation at a time; all OS-managed processes share account admission.
A timeout/interrupt request does not prove the external job stopped.
Resume or rebind only at a supported settled boundary; retain unknown effects and accounting.

contract.input: admitted CloudProcessSpec | specialist observation/repair + operation/binding refs
contract.output: typed cloud step/terminal result; actual provider/model and usage; pressure snapshot; cancellation/uncertainty status

nodes.title: Resume / owner / publication manifest
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION CONTINUATION
nodes.body: Persist private workspace/base, current development/reconciliation/assessment phase, captured shared head, both owner-token refs, pending shell/provider effects, commit/report/publication status and graph checkpoint. A crash or timeout does not prove protected work stopped. Reconcile effects and publication before releasing applicable exclusion or resuming. An old owner cannot publish without a fresh current-token/version check.

contract.input: process continuation + workspace/phase + both owners + pending effects/publication
contract.output: validated resume or explicit reconciliation wait/abort; no duplicated publication

nodes.title: Key frame · later version
nodes.subtitle: OS / DEFERRED
nodes.body: deferred broad snapshot feature from the original graph. Later capture a consistent manifest of plan/head/queue/control epoch, doc/memory versions, checkpoints and operation positions. Restoring it still reconciles external effects. Basic durable intents and trap-frame continuations are required now; they do not promise whole-machine power-loss recovery.
facts: No active provider job, billing or remote mutation is rolled back by restoring a snapshot.
Trigger after sprint management only once a capture/retention consistency protocol exists.

contract.input: later consistent-cut snapshot request
contract.output: retained key-frame manifest; not implemented by the G0 design

nodes.title: Senior resolution / commit undo
nodes.subtitle: AGENT REVIEW / OS ACTIONS
nodes.body: Only sprint-coordinator review resolves completed reports. Keep/revert/retry/defer is separate from provisional shared publication and the local assessment verdict. A revert acquires verification_gate, takes shell_mutex for commands, checks later/dependent work and blast radius, then publishes its new head before release. Retain original/revert commit relationships. Git avoids reconstructing inverse edits but does not remove conflict/dependency analysis.

contract.input: senior decision; original/provisional commits; dependents; expected shared head
contract.output: review disposition + recorded keep/revert/retry/defer; resulting head/checks

nodes.title: Verification critical section
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION OWNERSHIP
nodes.body: One process at a time owns final reconciliation through shared publication. Acquire only after outside shell ownership is released. Capture latest provisional head H, merge it into the private copy, run at least one specially prompted development loop, then final assessment, commit and shared head/report publication before release. The coordinator remains active; other agents continue private development. Inside this section acquire shell_mutex individually for commands, always in verification→shell order.

contract.input: ready private candidate + task/process; no held outside shell token
contract.output: queued | verification owner token + captured H | reconciled release

nodes.title: Shell mutex · one command
nodes.subtitle: OS / APPLICATION OWNERSHIP
nodes.body: Every managed shell/script command uses one global shell mutex, even when agents have separate code copies. This includes Git/build/test commands invoked through shell. Release after actual relevant completion, not merely command launch or timeout. Outside verification, finish/release shell before requesting verification. Inside verification, acquire/release shell per command; do not hold it while reasoning. Native/remote agent shell work must be brokered or declared incompatible with this guarantee.

contract.input: shell request + process/workspace + optional verification token
contract.output: queued | sole shell owner + command result | release/unknown-effect wait

nodes.title: Private code copy · base B
nodes.subtitle: AGENT / PER-PROCESS WORKSPACE
nodes.body: Every in-progress coding agent gets its own codebase copy at a recorded base B. Private non-shell edits, context preparation and model reasoning can overlap. All tool requests identify this workspace. Start with full working trees; a partial copy requires dependency/build/test closure and a full-project mapping before publication.

contract.input: claimed task + process + base B + required project context
contract.output: private workspace/ref + scoped tool context

nodes.title: Merge head / reconciliation dev
nodes.subtitle: AGENT / VERIFICATION PHASE
nodes.body: While holding verification_gate, preserve the private pre-merge delta, merge current shared head H into this agent copy, resolve conflicts, and run at least one LLM development loop with a special prompt to inspect incoming changes and necessary adaptations. Run this even after a clean merge. Bound further repair work, then run final testing/examination/assessment. Shell operations still use shell_mutex individually.

contract.input: verification token; original B/private delta; latest H; task/observations
contract.output: updated private tree + reconciliation loop evidence -> final assessment

edges.label: Quota / backpressure snapshot
edges.body: timestamped account-wide capacity/health/uncertainty informs deterministic orchestration. No invented exact remaining tokens from quota percentages.
edges.payload: PressureSnapshot; stale/unknown flags; reservations; queue age

edges.label: Dispatch / pressure policy
edges.body: normal pressure decisions use explicit safe points. Ordinary steering does not alter current agents: stop new local starts and finish the captured in-progress set first.
edges.payload: policy reason; task/binding versions; steering dispatch state

edges.label: Enqueue change brief
edges.body: durable deduplicated report/change event, retained before a summary is generated.
edges.payload: report ID; change summary; commit/evidence refs

edges.label: Final dispositions / history
edges.body: record resolution and cancellation without erasing the original report.
edges.payload: unique history event; task/spec/attempt; disposition

edges.label: Bounded documentation task
edges.body: queue an optional model-assisted doc update; no direct mutation of an active worker workspace.
edges.payload: captured backlog range; docs/code refs; TaskSpec; update bounds

edges.label: Pinned documentation / deltas
edges.body: immutable version and explicit pending delta range, not a half-updated shared file.
edges.payload: doc_version; artifact refs; unprocessed delta range

edges.label: Versioned senior notes
edges.body: proposed project-wide notes are host-published with sources and expected version.
edges.payload: note version; plan/report sources; bounded text

edges.label: Fail / uncertain / unresolved hazards
edges.body: record actual revision and blast radius, including unresolved code already present in v1 shared history.
edges.payload: agent commit; fail|uncertain|successful; unresolved status; affected scope

edges.label: Record steering for later planning
edges.body: append immediately; semantic application waits for the currently running local agents to finish.
edges.payload: ordered input range; pending steering

edges.label: Record steering / capture running locals
edges.body: stop new local starts; do not apply steering to current agents. Finish only the local process IDs already in progress, including those waiting on inference/tools/gate, then invoke the planner. Pending queue tasks do not have to finish.
edges.payload: pending input range; captured in-progress local IDs; completion reports

edges.label: Pinned notes / hazards
edges.body: bounded project context, distinct from current permissions and authoritative evidence. Urgent hazards can request a pause.
edges.payload: memory_version; source refs; hazard snapshot

edges.label: Pause / validated release
edges.body: reach a supported boundary, store a manifest and later revalidate/reconcile before resuming.
edges.payload: process; pause reason; expected versions; frame_ref

edges.label: Worker continuation refs
edges.body: checkpoint and operation identity/counters, never an assumed model-internal snapshot.
edges.payload: checkpoint; task/base/tree; pending effects; counters; bindings

edges.label: Cloud continuation refs
edges.body: include native session/job ID only with declared adapter resume/reconciliation support.
edges.payload: checkpoint; provider session/job; pending effects; reservations

edges.label: Task ledger resume references
edges.body: frame references versioned task state and claim identity rather than copying a moving queue.
edges.payload: task/spec/claim refs

edges.label: Memory / steering references
edges.body: resume validates current control epoch and retained input range; an old frame cannot reopen admission.
edges.payload: memory version; control epoch; steering range

edges.label: Unprocessed doc range / cursor
edges.body: retain reports not yet reflected in documentation and recover the captured batch without duplicate acknowledgement.
edges.payload: doc version; backlog refs; cursor

edges.label: Senior invocation references
edges.body: the execution is owned by the conductor; role inputs/mode are retained with the process continuation.
edges.payload: mode/context refs; cloud process ID

edges.label: Queue / plan refs
edges.body: later consistent-cut input; not an additional G0 runtime dependency.
edges.payload: versioned manifest refs

edges.label: Memory / steering refs
edges.body: later consistent-cut input; not an additional G0 runtime dependency.
edges.payload: versioned manifest refs

edges.label: Control / continuation refs
edges.body: later consistent-cut input; not an additional G0 runtime dependency.
edges.payload: versioned manifest refs

edges.label: Later sprint-boundary key frame
edges.body: preserve the original deferred trigger; snapshot only under a defined consistency protocol.
edges.payload: post-review capture request

edges.label: Reviewed disposition / resulting revision
edges.body: senior resolution identifies original/revert commits; shared notes or successful tests cannot auto-resolve.
edges.payload: review decision; original/revert SHA; affected work

edges.label: Publish head/report, then release
edges.body: keep verification ownership until real commit and provisional head/unresolved report publication are durable; reconcile uncertainty before release.
edges.payload: captured H; P; report ref; publication/release state

edges.label: Acquire verification for senior undo
edges.body: senior revert serializes with reconciliation/testing/publication. Its shell commands also use shell_mutex; publish new head before release.
edges.payload: original commit; later dependents; expected H; review decision

edges.label: Confirmed command end → release
edges.body: release shell after relevant work/effects end; unknown/background effects preserve exclusion.
edges.payload: shell token; operation; result/effect certainty

edges.label: Inside: verification → shell only
edges.body: acquire/release shell individually for commands; never wait for verification while holding an outside shell token.
edges.payload: verification token; scoped command request

edges.label: Next entrant sees published P
edges.body: a private-only commit is insufficient; next verification owner captures updated provisional_head.
edges.payload: P; unresolved hazards; authoritative head

edges.label: Private state / merge provenance
edges.body: retain original B, workspace, pre-merge delta, captured H, phase, both owner refs and publication state.
edges.payload: workspace/base/head/phase refs
